answer: Price replication explicitly: log what one identity costs to build, cap its per-epoch credit at that price, and require any payout quorum to span unrelated subnetworks, so a copy earns nothing until it buys peers it does not own. That cap turns a plume of clones into a measurable ripple in the operator budget instead of a dune of free credit, and a thousand clones pay a thousand setup costs with no shortcut.
